Knowledge Sharing

Teaching GIS the way it is used — practical, case-based, tool-first

As an instructor and speaker I deliver trainings on land cover mapping, spatial analysis and machine learning with Python for geospatial data — for Geosoftware.ID, Logis Map and Asbim Indonesia (Madhava Persada Group). Every session is built around a real case, so participants work directly in QGIS, Google Earth Engine and reproducible Python pipelines instead of slides-only theory. It reflects my commitment to knowledge sharing and to continuous skill development in the geospatial field.
